title: Shrimp & Tamago Futomaki
description: Large rolls combining cooked shrimp, omelet, carrot and cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Beat eggs with mirin and soy sauce. Cook gently in thin folded layers or as a thick omelet until fully set, then slice into strips.
Blanch carrot matchsticks briefly and cool. Cut cucumber into even, dry batons.
Cook shrimp until opaque throughout; drain thoroughly and cool.
Spread rice over a full nori sheet, keeping a clear band at the edge. Arrange shrimp, egg, carrot and cucumber lengthwise; roll firmly.
Slice each large roll into eight thick pieces with a clean wet knife.
notes: Dry all fillings well to avoid soggy rice.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Cook shrimp thoroughly until the flesh is opaque throughout.
